name: Yiqi Qushi recipe
short: Only one 8-week trial in 40 people with myasthenia gravis (20 on the formula): no adverse reactions with the formula; 2 on pyridostigmine had mild diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting.
text: The only safety evidence found is one 8-week randomized trial in 40 people with type I or II myasthenia gravis, in which 20 took Yiqi Qushi recipe and 20 took pyridostigmine (a conventional myasthenia gravis medicine), with a safety evaluation. No adverse reaction occurred in the formula group, while mild diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting occurred in two people taking pyridostigmine. The trial is small and short, and the abstract does not list the herbs in the formula. No interaction data were found in the cited source.
